card.name: Journal citation volume and DOI pieces
card.fires_on: Punctuation and digits inside scientific journal citations, such as the colon, comma or number after a volume, and parts of a DOI string. Also fires on a forum 'users browsing' count line.

modes.label: Citation volume/page
modes.description: Colon, comma or digit after a journal name, year and volume number.
modes.example: Espinosa-Soto et al. BMC Evolutionary Biology 2011 11<<:>>5 doi:10.11

modes.label: Inside a DOI
modes.description: Digits or slashes within a doi string.

modes.label: Forum guest count
modes.description: Words and numbers in the 'No registered users and 2 guests' line.
modes.example: Users browsing this forum: No registered users and <<2>> guests

card.writes: Suggests a continuation of a citation or identifier string, such as a number or a short code piece.
card.plain: It lights up on the small numbers and punctuation inside reference citations and DOI codes.
